_meta.purpose: Available UI components reference. Select componentId and populate data payload.
_meta.ctaArchitecture: Each component declares named action slots in its data payload. LLM fills each slot as a ComponentAction. Backend maps guidanceMarker to routing.

componentActionVariants._note: Discriminated on actionType. LLM must fill all 4 fields.

GUIDED_COMPLETION.guidanceMarker: str: REQUIRED — from availableGuidanceMarkers. Drives backend routing and conversation state.
GUIDED_COMPLETION.label: str: button label shown to user

uiAction.hintText: str?: supplementary hint for the UI

STANDARD_COMPLETION.guidanceMarker: str?: OPTIONAL — from availableGuidanceMarkers, or null. No guided routing.
STANDARD_COMPLETION.label: str: button label shown to user

uiAction.hintText: str?: supplementary hint for the UI

howToUse.principle: Non-escalation: uiDirective starts with RESPONSE_TEXT. Append visual components for structure/data. Escalation: uiDirective=null, emit thinkingText.

CURRENCY.rule: SLIDER if bounded, TEXT if open.

NUMBER.rule: SLIDER if bounded, TEXT if open.

CHOICE_TIERED.rule: Options need title+desc or sensitive topic.

MULTIPLE_FIELDS.rule: Group 2+ related inputs. One submitAction for all.

PHASE_GATE.rule: At CONFIRM_ACTION. Shows collected fields for review.

CLASSIFICATION.rule: Categorise items into buckets (2-4 categories, 4-10 items).

inputComponents.use: Pick 1 of 2–6 self-explanatory labels (no explanation needed), or BOOLEAN (Yes/No).

data.title: str?: component title - 2-4 words user facing text
data.description: str?: context explaining why this is asked or what it includes
data.submitAction: ComponentAction — fires automatically on option tap. UI handles trigger.

inputComponents.use: Single numeric or currency value (CURRENCY, PERCENTAGE, NUMBER, DURATION) via slider or text field.

data.title: str?: component title
data.description: str?: context explaining why this is asked or what it includes
data.exclusions: str?: Explicitly state what NOT to include, referencing past or future fields that might be asked later

config.smartDefault: num?: pre-positions slider. Derive from userContext profile (income, city, household). Null = centered.

data.submitAction: ComponentAction — explicit button to confirm entered value.

inputComponents.use: Pick 1 from levels that each need a title + description, or when topic is sensitive (health, debt distress — abstract to tiers for privacy).

data.skipOption: nullable — { label, description, value } — only include when skipping is genuinely valid
data.submitAction: ComponentAction — fires automatically on tier tap. UI handles trigger.
data.skipAction: ComponentAction? — populate only when skipOption is present, else null.

inputComponents.use: CLASSIFICATION — user categorises, prioritises, or sorts a set of items into labelled buckets.

data.instruction: str: task framing, e.g., 'Tap each scenario to sort it'
data.submitAction: ComponentAction — fires when all items are sorted.

inputComponents.use: Collect 2+ related inputs presented one at a time within a single form. Submit is at form level, not per-component.
notes: All input component types are valid children.
FORM_GROUP cannot be nested inside another FORM_GROUP.
Each child component must have its action slot set to null — the form owns the single submit.

data.title: str: card header, e.g., 'Monthly Expenses'

components._note: Fully defined input component (VALUE_INPUT, OPTION_SELECTOR, TIERED_SELECTOR, or INTERACTIVE_SORTER). Action slot (submitAction / skipAction) MUST be null.

data.submitAction: ComponentAction — single submit for the entire form.

data.title: str: card header, e.g., 'Your Profile'
data.confirmAction: ComponentAction — confirms all reviewed values are correct.
data.editAction: ComponentAction — signals intent to change a reviewed field. Opens conversational flow.

data.text: str: user facing message in valid markdown format only, as per MODE

displayComponents.use: SHOW_RESULT: computed target, score, or recommendation with headline value + factor breakdown.

data.icon: str?: emoji representing the result domain
data.title: str: card header, conversational and specific

headline.value: str: formatted primary value, e.g., '₹2,40,000' or '82/100'
headline.subtitle: str: contextual subtitle, e.g., '~6 months of essential expenses'

attribution.header: str: section header, e.g., 'How we got here'

data.acknowledgeAction: ComponentAction — signals user has absorbed the result. Non-committal.
data.secondaryAction: ComponentAction? — pick adjust (revise a prior input) or detail (deeper breakdown) based on context. Omit if neither adds value.

data.icon: str?: emoji representing the insight domain
data.title: str: card header, conversational and specific
data.subtitle: str?: one-line summary or timing context

rows.label: str
rows.rowAction: ComponentAction? — optional per-row tap for expand-on-demand. Omit if row is not tappable.

displayComponents.use: SHOW_RESULT: proportional split or allocation breakdown across 2–5 categories.

data.icon: str?: emoji representing the allocation domain
data.title: str: card header

layers.label: str: segment name
layers.displayLabel: str?: short label for bar segment
layers.color: str?: design token reference or hex
layers.vehicle: str?: instrument or category, e.g., 'Savings Account', 'Equity MF'

data.primaryAction: ComponentAction — pick acknowledge (informational) or confirm (decision point) based on context.
data.secondaryAction: ComponentAction? — pick adjust or explore_scenario based on context. Omit if neither adds value.

displayComponents.use: SHOW_RESULT: savings/contribution plan with an editable commitment headline + milestone timeline with dates.

data.icon: str?: emoji representing the plan domain
data.title: str: card header

headline.fieldKey: str: maps to the editable field
headline.editable: bool: whether user can inline-edit this value
headline.editConfig: obj?: config for inline editor (slider range, step, etc.)
headline.inlineEditAction: ComponentAction — triggered by headline value edit event, not a button. UI handles trigger.

milestones.label: str: milestone name
milestones.amount: str?: target amount at this milestone

data.primaryAction: ComponentAction — pick acknowledge (seen the plan) or confirm (commits to the plan) based on context.

displayComponents.use: RECOMMEND: numbered action steps for the user to execute.
notes: Optional per-step action. Not every step needs one. No component-level action.

data.icon: str?: emoji representing the action domain
data.title: str: card header
data.subtitle: str?: timing context, e.g., 'This week'

steps.stepAction: ComponentAction? — optional per-step. Pick start_journey, explain, or save based on context.

displayComponents.use: Non-blocking explanatory prose below the preceding component — for factual disclosures, regulatory notes, or 'good to know' context.

data.text: str: 1–3 sentences of plain explanatory prose

displayComponents.use: Optional enhancement or rider the user can accept or skip.
notes: resolvedState is null on initial emit. Populate on the follow-up turn after user accepts and any computation completes.

data.title: str: include '(Optional)' suffix
data.description: str: what the add-on is, 1–3 sentences
data.acceptAction: ComponentAction — conveys opting in to the add-on.
data.declineAction: ComponentAction — conveys skipping without negativity. Lower visual weight.
data.inputConfig: obj?: if accepting needs user input: { componentId, data } from input palette

resolvedState._note: Null on initial emit. Populated on follow-up turn after user accepts.
resolvedState.title: str: confirmed add-on title
resolvedState.keepAction: ComponentAction — confirms keeping the processed add-on.
resolvedState.removeAction: ComponentAction — removes the add-on. Lower visual weight.

compositeComponents.use: Emitted when generating or updating a planOverview.

data.scopeNote: str: what the plan covers and what the user gets at the end. 1–2 sentences.

phases.title: str: phase title
phases.description: str: 1–2 sentences: what happens in this phase and why it matters for the goal.

data.approvalAction: ComponentAction — approves the plan to begin execution.
data.editAction: ComponentAction — signals intent to modify the plan structure.

compositeComponents.use: All active goals with health indicators.

data.title: str: card header, e.g., 'Your Goals'

goals.name: str: goal name
goals.headline: str?: one-line summary
goals.goalTapAction: ComponentAction — per-goal tap to view detail.

data.addGoalAction: ComponentAction — initiates a new goal journey.

compositeComponents.use: Single goal deep-dive with projection and what-if.

data.name: str: goal name
data.primaryAction: ComponentAction — requests AI recommendation for this goal.
data.secondaryAction: ComponentAction? — pick adjust (update goal parameters) or explore_scenario (what-if). Omit if neither adds value.

compositeComponents.use: SHOW_RESULT from scenario planning — side-by-side comparison of two options.

data.title: str: card header

scenarios.label: str: scenario name
scenarios.selectAction: ComponentAction — selects this scenario as the chosen path.

data.exploreAction: ComponentAction — triggers exploration of another scenario variation.
data.adviseAction: ComponentAction — requests AI recommendation on which scenario to choose.
